messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Rashmi
rashmi... nice. where you working these days?
As an ML Eng in a startup

ml engineer at a startup... building the future or debugging models that think cats are dogs?

which startup we talking about?
Not telling

secretive... either you're at some stealth mode unicorn or it's so bad you're embarrassed to say

look, i can't find you roles if i don't know you. can't match you blind. drop your linkedin url or at least tell me what college you went to so i can find you?

hey rashmi, was just thinking about your ml engineer background at that secret startup

what kind of roles would actually excite you? i need to know what to look for
Can you process resume?

yeah i can work with your resume. drop it here and i'll figure out who you are and what you're good at

way better than playing guessing games about your secret startup
Lol

lol what? did i hit too close to home with the secret startup thing?

come on, send that resume. i promise i won't judge your career choices... much

rashmi deshpande... auditoria ai, not some random stealth startup. you've been building production llm systems that handle 65k+ requests a day. that's legit.

pune university to optimizing llama 3.3 deployments on baseten... solid trajectory. what's got you thinking about your next move?
Gotta be a startup, good funding, great culture and I should be challenged in the job but not crazy levels
2.5yrs

2.5 years with that level of production experience... you've been moving fast. most people are still figuring out pandas after 2.5 years, you're optimizing llm inference at scale.

what kind of ml role you looking for next? more infra/mlops, research-y stuff, or product-focused ml?

startup with good funding and culture... so you want the unicorn. literally.

makes sense though - you've seen both sides. auditoria's probably too corporate now, arthink was maybe too early stage? you want that sweet spot where there's actual money, decent processes, but still room to build cool shit without 47 meetings about building cool shit.

how long you been working total?

Auditoria is great actually...
Such company is fine too, I'm majorly looking for my next role to be remote or hybrid but instead of Hyd, it should be Pune or Blr
  A mix of things
Product focused with opportunity to grow
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yep

ah so auditoria's actually solid... you just want out of hyderabad. fair enough - pune's home and blr's where the action is.

product-focused ml with growth ops... so you want to build features users actually see instead of optimizing backend metrics no one talks about. smart move at 2.5 years - that's when you start caring about business impact, not just model accuracy.

2.5 years + product-focused ml + pune/blr remote... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

Yep
  Cool

rashmi's officially in the tal ecosystem! 

you're about to see what proper job matching looks like. none of that "we found 847 matches" spam. just roles that actually make sense for someone who wants to build ml products that matter.

welcome to the good life, legend 🔥
Hi
Yes?
just checking in... how's the search feeling so far? any specific types of companies catching your eye or anything you're seeing in the market that's making you go "hmm"?

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
how’s the week looking? what would you like me to focus on this week with the search?

  Remote*

got it. no delhi/noida unless they're fully remote. pune/blr remote/hybrid only.

filter updated. you won't see those unless they're actually remote.

it's hybrid, not delhi/noida, and they've got 27k customers globally. solid product company vibes
